items.title: Paper cut-out film
items.note: Layered paper hills and a blue shadow box that holds Fabric, with a green desk for Eranos. Weak spots: the hills get busy behind the box, and it reads a little storybook for an infrastructure product. Uses the earlier, longer script: compare the look, not the words.

items.title: Tabletop card game film
items.note: Fabric as a game on a table: two decks, a pawn and a mat, with a drifting camera and blurred near objects. Weak spots: card text is small at phone size and the camera can crop side labels while it pushes in. Uses the earlier, longer script: compare the look, not the words.

items.title: Simple 3D film, live in the browser
items.note: Rough pass, 3:00 with voice. Teleion Fabric as one bounded section with the three parts lit one at a time, then real Eranos pages on screens. Being improved: an empty moment at 2:27, and labels that collide on phones. Sound with picture hasn't been tested in real time.

items.title: Ray-traced communication blocks, first stills
items.note: Six still frames, not video yet. Tasks are blue blocks and Task Objects are black. Illustration. Motion is rendering now.
